_meta.indication: PIFELTRO, a non-nucleoside reverse transcriptase inhibitor (NNRTI), is indicated in combination with other antiretroviral agents for the treatment of HIV-1 infection in adult patients with no prior antiretroviral treatment history.

pivotal_trials.design: Multicenter, randomized, double-blind, active-controlled noninferiority trial; subjects randomized 1:1 to DOR 100 mg QD or DRV+r 800/100 mg QD, each with an NRTI background, stratified by NRTI background and screening HIV-1 RNA.
pivotal_trials.population: HIV-1-infected, antiretroviral treatment-naïve adults (at least 18 years of age).
pivotal_trials.endpoint: Proportion of subjects with HIV-1 RNA <50 copies/mL at Week 48 (FDA snapshot algorithm).
pivotal_trials.result: At Week 48, 83.8% (DOR) vs 79.9% (DRV/r) had HIV-1 RNA <50 copies/mL; treatment difference 3.9% (95.001% CI: -1.6%, 9.4%), meeting the prespecified noninferiority margin.

pivotal_trials.design: Multicenter, randomized, double-blind, active-controlled noninferiority trial; subjects randomized 1:1 to DOR/3TC/TDF 100/300/300 mg QD or EFV/FTC/TDF 600/200/300 mg QD, stratified by screening HIV-1 RNA and HBV and/or HCV coinfection.
pivotal_trials.population: HIV-1-infected, antiretroviral treatment-naïve adults (at least 18 years of age).
pivotal_trials.endpoint: Proportion of subjects with HIV-1 RNA <50 copies/mL at Week 48 (FDA snapshot algorithm).
pivotal_trials.result: At Week 48, 84.3% (DOR/3TC/TDF) vs 80.8% (EFV/FTC/TDF) had HIV-1 RNA <50 copies/mL; treatment difference 3.5% (95% CI: -2.0%, 9.0%), meeting the prespecified noninferiority margin.

key_safety: Most common adverse reactions (incidence ≥5%, all grades) are nausea, dizziness, headache, fatigue, diarrhea, abdominal pain, and abnormal dreams. In DRIVE-FORWARD, PIFELTRO (N=383) rates included nausea 7%, headache 6%, fatigue 6%, diarrhea 5%, and abdominal pain 5%.
target_moa: Doravirine is a pyridinone non-nucleoside reverse transcriptase inhibitor (NNRTI) of HIV-1 that inhibits HIV-1 replication by non-competitive inhibition of HIV-1 reverse transcriptase, without inhibiting human cellular DNA polymerases.

rems.type: No REMS are recommended based on the available DOR information.

advisory_committee.vote: The application was not referred to an FDA advisory committee because it did not raise significant safety or efficacy issues unexpected for doravirine's drug class.

summary.text: PIFELTRO (doravirine) NDA 210806 was a Standard review reviewed together with the DELSTRIGO fixed-dose combination; it was approved on the basis of two randomized Phase 3 noninferiority trials (DRIVE-FORWARD [P018] and DRIVE-AHEAD [P021]) without accelerated approval, and was not referred to an advisory committee.

The primary evidence of efficacy of doravirine was provided by two pivotal Phase 3 trials (DRIVE-FORWARD [P018] and DRIVE-AHEAD [P021]) in antiretroviral treatment-naïve, HIV-1 infected subjects.

Your application for PIFELTRO™ (doravirine) was not referred to an FDA advisory committee because the application did not raise significant safety or efficacy issues that were unexpected for doravirine's drug class and there were no controversial issues that would benefit from advisory committee discussion.

requirement.text: 3415-1: Conduct a study to evaluate the pharmacokinetics, safety and antiviral activity of doravirine in HIV-1 infected pediatric subjects less than 18 years of age and weighing at least 35 kg (minimum 24 weeks).

The safety and antiviral activity of doravirine in pediatric subjects must be evaluated for a minimum of 24 weeks.

requirement.text: 3415-2: Conduct a study to evaluate the pharmacokinetics, safety and antiviral activity of doravirine in HIV-1 infected pediatric subjects at least 2 years of age and weighing less than 35 kg (followed a minimum of 24 weeks).

requirement.text: 3415-4: Assess the phenotypic susceptibility in cell culture of doravirine and approved NNRTIs against Y318F alone and in combination with specified resistance substitutions.

citations.quote: 3415-4 Assess the phenotypic susceptibility in cell culture of doravirine and approved non-nucleoside reverse transcriptase inhibitors (NNRTIs) against Y318F alone and in combination with the following substitutions, which have been associated with doravirine and/or other NNRTIs: K103N; Y181C; K103N/Y181C; L100I; L100I/K103N; V106A; P225H; V106A/P225H; H221Y; V106M; F227C; V108I.

requirement.text: 3415-5: Conduct a drug-drug interaction study of the pharmacokinetics of doravirine and its primary metabolite (M9) when doravirine 100 mg BID is coadministered with rifabutin versus doravirine 100 mg QD alone in healthy subjects.
